IF
AddedTo(S_UND_MyconidCircle_BootsOfSpeed_fca76ec8-f3dd-446c-bd69-dc2f6ccca285,(CHARACTER)_PlayerSpecific, _)
AND
DB_Players(_PlayerSpecific)
AND
NOT DB_PermaDefeated(S_GLO_InjuredGnome_fcf53ac7-1805-4e57-b6ed-4f7b0f90cf96)
AND
QuestUpdateIsUnlocked(_PlayerSpecific,"UND_LoneDuergar","PersuadedBoots",0)
THEN
QuestUpdate("UND_LoneDuergar","StoleBoots");

IF
DB_InRegion(_Player, _Trigger)
AND
DB_GLO_MonkAmuletBanters(_Trigger, _Banter)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
NOT DB_GLO_MonkAmulet_EquippingPlayer(_)
AND
GetEquippedItem(_Player,"Amulet",S_UND_MonkAmulet_Amulet_de2ea5a9-943a-4794-9ef7-208be7747178)
THEN
DB_GLO_MonkAmulet_EquippingPlayer(_Player);

IF
KilledBy((CHARACTER)S_TUT_Lab_TrappedDevourer_6ca92237-eb1e-4ed8-a1ee-18b3bef21558,_Character,_,_)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag(COL_Morgue_State_UsInColony_8e0a2351-4e88-0b3f-4088-6de33da0ddd4)
AND
GetRelation((FACTION)ACT2_COL_Butcher_04637de8-a921-4c0f-80b3-1f25ed3e4f8c,(FACTION)ACT0_TUT_LabDevourer_55adef8a-dea9-4f20-9af4-1045ec79e749,_Relation)
AND
_Relation > 0
AND
CrimeGetNewID(_CrimeId)
THEN
DebugText(_Character,"|Killed Us.|");
PROC_CharacterRegisterCrime((CHARACTER)_Character,"COL_Morgue_Us_Freed",S_COL_Morgue_Cage_Us_5f3613eb-f290-4828-80dc-167ed16134d4,S_COL_Butcher_82ebdca0-f478-4c2b-a529-179a7e82b3db,_CrimeId);

IF
UseStarted(_Player, (ITEM)S_LOW_SubmersibleInteriorLadder_8b3d25e5-4fb6-4207-8f67-82b7f6de1db9)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
THEN
TeleportTo(_Player, S_LOW_DockWarehouse_ReturnFromIronThronePos_d1a59a82-8b4b-4f0a-a382-14a997888333, "LOW_IronTrone_ReturnedToBasement", 1, 1, 1, 0, 1);

QRY
QRY_EPI_Epilogue_LetterIsValid((ITEM)S_EPI_Letter_IsobelNightsong_5c47e3d7-1246-4f26-a9b5-d56670fb5afc)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag(SHA_Nightsong_State_PermaDefeated_d02e8ea4-dec7-4824-8117-efc075dee4ba)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag(LOW_SorcerousSundries_State_NightsongCaged_d9739530-c72a-4ad8-96f0-7ec71bbcfd98)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag(SCE_Isobel_State_WillJoinCamp_bd91b63d-9c38-1399-cb7d-9eeddff8b039)
AND
NOT DB_PermaDefeated(S_GLO_Isobel_263bfbfc-6160-46f4-a9e1-1089cdb5c211)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);
